svg.title: Nitish Sundarraj: power, silicon, robots, cloud
svg.desc: A rainy neon street at night. Nitish's name glows on a brick wall next to a door marked portfolio. He eats noodles beside a stall whose sign reads BUG-FREE RAMEN, run by a robot in a chef hat. The FREE tube flickers out, a bug climbs onto his chopsticks, he drops it into a jar that goes from 14 to 15 bugs, says that's bug #15, and the sign lights up again.
